title: Colander Stainless Steel 3-Quart, Strainer for Kitchen Food, Dishwasher Safe
description:
About this item
【USING】It can get rid from the frill water and oils of your pasta in a few seconds or clean your potatoes, tomatoes, berries, and every other vegetable and fruit effortlessly. We can use it in family gatherings, outings, and picnics, also a perfect idea kitchen decorations.
【DESIGN】Tiny and closely spaced holes mean your food drains fast, the mesh is sturdy and will not warp, stretch, or snag even under heavy foods(In particular, spaghetti won't fall through the holes); Footed design facilitates fast, easy drainage, the sturdy solid ring base keeps the colander from tipping over.
【MATERIAL】Made of professional-grade 18/10, 304 stainless steel, it is rust and will never affect the taste of your food!
【DIMENSION】The maximum diameter of the colander is 8.8", the longest length including the handle is 11", and the whole height is 3.9". The 3-quart capacity makes this attractive even for small restaurants and food trucks.
【AFTER SALE SERVICE】We are committed to providing each customer with the highest standard of customer service and top-quality goods, if you are not satisfied with our product or service for any reason, please contact us and we will provide the best solution for every dear customer!
